  • from the initial proposal to final delivery, within the agreed timeframe.
  • Develop strong and effective relationships and communication with customers.
  • Deliver technical and administrative field reports.
  • Maintain and update the CRM system and other control tools.
  • Promote a culture of personal and team/customer safety.
  • Work independently with limited supervision

What You Bring

  • Technical degree or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in the mining industry (desirable).
  • Good working knowledge of parts and maintenance of mining equipment such as Thickeners, Flotation Cells, Filters, HPGRs, Mills and Crushers
  • Intermediate English and/or Spanish (desirable).
  • Availability to reside in or near the cities listed above.
  • Availability to travel when required.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Solid knowledge of MS Office, Outlook, and CRM systems.

What We Offer

  • Market-competitive salary and benefits package
  • Health insurance.
  • Meal vouchers.
  • Bonus program.
  • Private pension plan.
  • Internal and international opportunities to develop your career.

title: Structuring Sr. Analyst
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Portfolio Support

  • Ongoing oversight of existing investments, including contract enforcement, regulatory updates, risk mitigation and management report.
  • Support portfolio management such as quotaholders’ meetings discussions and approvals, monitoring existing portfolio, solving structuring and portfolio matters through creative solutions and facilitating collaboration with external third parties, Local teams and Global teams, as needed; and
  • Maintain fluid communication with Local and Global teams, external service providers and originators to ensure alignment on portfolio health.

Deal Flow Support

  • Support the team reviewing, and negotiating investment agreements, ensuring full alignment with Credit Committee approvals and regulatory requirements.
  • Support the team in coordinating legal and structuring analysis for new opportunities, identifying potential "red flags" and proposing mitigation structures.
  • Support team in preparing materials for the Credit Committee, ensuring that the legal risks and structural safeguards of every deal are clearly communicated.
  • Act as a point of contact for external legal advisors, fund managers, and originators to ensure timely and cost-effective closing of new deals; and
  • Maintain fluid communication with Lending and Credit Risk teams to ensure that new deal structures are not only legally robust but also commercially viable and tax-efficiency

General Support

  • Supporting and coordinating cross-functional structuring initiatives, improving reporting and monitoring structures and periodically routines with stakeholders.
  • Support the team in addressing and clarifying matters that may arise from new investments and/or existing portfolios.
  • Support knowledge sharing and internal development initiatives through the preparation of materials or participation in training activities.

Requirements

  • 3 to 5 years of experience as a lawyer in securitized environment, credit operations, including capital markets transactions such Debentures, CRIs/CRAs and FIDCs.
  • Has worked as in-house counsel, in a top law firm and/or in a fund manager or fund administrator.
  • Bachelor’s degree in law.
  • Duly registered with the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB).
  • Strong ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Clear and objective communication skills for interaction with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Excellent legal and structuring technical skills, organized and strong attention to detail.
  • Experience with credit lifecycle process and delinquency/collection management is a strong plus.
  • Familiar with Excel spreadsheets.
  • Solid interpersonal and collaborative abilities.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care, and body care brands.

At Coty, we celebrate and nurture a culture of kindness. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and believe that beauty lies in diversity. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where all talents can shine and where different perspectives drive innovation and growth.

JOB OVERVIEW

Lead and oversee all Facilities operations across Corporate Offices, R&D Labs, Manufacturing Plant, and Distribution Center, ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective infrastructure. Drive operational excellence through strong vendor management, robust maintenance programs, and continuous improvement. Act as the key connection between local operations and global standards for EHS, Engineering, and Sustainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a strong safety culture and full compliance with legal requirements, NRs, company HSE policies, and global corporate standards.
  • Guarantee the integrity, reliability, and availability of all facilities infrastructure, including utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, water treatment, fire protection, building automation, and critical assets.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee internal and outsourced teams (maintenance, cleaning, security, reception, gardening, cafeteria, and services).
  • Manage preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance programs, ensuring uptime and operational continuity for Office, R&D Labs, Manufacturing, and Distribution Center.
  • Oversee facilities services to ensure high service levels, cost efficiency, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives to enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, waste reduction, and operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with certifications, internal audits, external audits, and global standards (ISO, GMP where applicable).
  • Oversee space planning, workplace strategy, building layout updates, and occupancy optimization.
  • Manage construction projects, renovations, expansions, and infrastructure modifications from planning to delivery, ensuring alignment with Capex governance.
  • Coordinate incident management, emergency response plans, fire brigade activities, and building security protocols.
  • Monitor and manage facilities KPIs, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage Opex and Capex budgets, ensuring cost optimization and adherence to financial targets.
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, HR, IT, Security, Finance) to ensure seamless and compliant operations.
  • Ensure vendor management excellence, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for facilities matters with local leadership and global functional teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience managing Facilities operations across multi-site or complex environments (Office, Industrial, Logistics, or R&D).
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, or facilities services.
  • Strong technical background in building systems (HVAC, electrical, utilities, fire systems).
  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance management, vendor management, and project leadership.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.
  • Proven experience in managing Capex and Opex budgets.
  • Experience in multinational environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

title: LLM Application Engineer
description:
The Role

You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources
  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection
  • Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications
  • Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems
  • Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available
  • Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically
  • Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.

What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

  • Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.
  • Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it
  • Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management
  • Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)
  • Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging
  • Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)
  • Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings
  • Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services
  • Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric , Power BI , or Azure ecosystem

Why This Role

  • Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.
  • Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.
  • Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.
  • Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

Profissionais da área comercial com mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para congressos e feiras. Podem estar baseados no México, Colômbia, Brasil, Argentina, Uruguai, Panamá ou Miami, Estados Unidos.

Quais serão suas responsabilidades e funções?

  • Superar metas de vendas, com foco em garantir patrocínios das principais empresas de tecnologia para nossos congressos e feiras.
  • Gerenciar e cultivar relações sólidas com clientes existentes, garantindo uma experiência contínua e satisfatória.
  • Implementar estratégias para assegurar a retenção e renovação de contas-chave na carteira, transformando clientes em contas estratégicas, ampliando negócios por meio de upselling e cross-selling .
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento nas contas atribuídas, antecipando e atendendo às necessidades em constante mudança dos clientes.
  • Desenvolver planos e estratégias para ampliar a participação e maximizar o valor de cada conta.
  • Explorar ativamente novas oportunidades de negócios, identificando clientes potenciais e setores estratégicos.

Requisitos

  • Capacidade comprovada de vender e negociar em inglês.
  • Perfil hunter , com habilidades de prospecção, busca ativa de oportunidades, proatividade, autonomia, resiliência, aprendizado rápido e forte orientação para resultados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, além de sólidas competências de negociação.
  • Disponibilidade e recursos para trabalhar em tempo integral no modelo home office .
  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de intangíveis, patrocínios, sponsorships, estandes.
  • Experiência em negociação com executivos C-Levels, VPs e gerentes de marketing regionais de grandes empresas tecnológicas da região e globais.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de transformação digital, TICs, Big Data, software, IoT, e-commerce e marketing digital.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado em CRM, Microsoft Office e softwares de produtividade em vendas.

O que oferecemos? Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Salário base competitivo + as melhores comissões do mercado.
  • Cultura de trabalho colaborativa, ambiente multicultural com profissionais de diferentes países.
  • Fazer parte de uma empresa em constante crescimento.
  • Colaborar e aprender junto a profissionais e especialistas renomados.
  • Estar na vanguarda dos processos de vendas B2B e negociação.

Sobre nós

Através dos nossos congressos no Chile, México e Estados Unidos (), somos o ponto de encontro entre fornecedores globais e locais de soluções tecnológicas em Inteligência Artificial, Cloud, Big Data, IoT, Indústria 4.0, Telecomunicações, Software, Fintech, Web3, e-commerce, Marketing Digital e CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CMOs, CDOs, CISOs, CFOs, líderes de negócios, inovação e transformação digital de operadoras, bancos, varejo, indústrias (manufatura, energia, petróleo e gás, mineração, agroindústria, utilities) e autoridades governamentais, ajudando-os a acelerar sua transformação digital e a migrar a economia dos países para uma economia digital.

Através do America Digital News TV (), somos o principal canal de TV e mídia online focado em notícias nas áreas de Inteligência Artificial, Inovação, Tecnologia, Negócios e Transformação Digital, alcançando atualmente mais de 145.000 assinantes.

Nossa missão

Através dos nossos congressos e meio online, ser o maior ecossistema de networking, capacitação e informação nas áreas de IA, Tecnologia, Transformação Digital e Negócios.

No momento da candidatura, responder às seguintes perguntas e enviar para:

  1. Você possui um espaço de home office ? (Espaço privado onde possa fechar a porta, trabalhar sem interrupções, horário integral, boa conexão à internet).
  2. Você é um vendedor de vendas B2B e consultivas? Explique por quê.
  3. Qual é sua experiência em vendas de intangíveis B2B, como vendas de patrocínios para congressos ou eventos?
  4. Quantos anos de experiência você tem em vendas B2B? Especifique onde e detalhe sua experiência.
  5. Quais foram seus resultados de vendas em 2022, 2023 e 2024? Detalhe o quê, quem, quanto e como.
  6. Qual é o seu nível de domínio do Microsoft Office e CRMs? Quais CRMs já utilizou? Classifique de 1 a 7.
  7. Descreva três pontos fortes e três pontos fracos. Você se considera um vendedor nato? Possui perfil comercial? Explique por quê.
  8. Quais treinamentos realizou em vendas B2B, vendas consultivas e negociação? Detalhe.
  9. O que está fazendo atualmente? Qual é sua disponibilidade?
  10. Classifique seu nível de inglês de 1 a 10. Possui nível C1 (9)?
  11. Quais são suas expectativas salariais? Informar fixo e variável.
  12. Revise , , e indique como você pode contribuir para os objetivos comerciais de venda de patrocínios para o Congresso América Digital e para a venda do nosso meio America Digital News TV ().

title: OCI Administration
description:
Job Title: OCI Administration

Location: Brazil

Duration:12 months plus contract

Rate: DOE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Linux/Unix Administration.
  • 3+ Years experience in OCI Administration - Tenancy, VCN, Compartments, Network Layers, handling firewalls, subnets, storage options, FSS, Block Volume, Object storage.

Responsibilities:

• Oracle WebLogic Software installation and Maintenance (11.x, 12.x and 14.x versions)

• Installing WebLogic patches, service packs etc.

• WebLogic Application Server administration.

• Performance monitoring and tuning - Basic

• Carrying out Thread Dump Analysis, Heap dump analysis etc.

• Configuring of LDAP and Security realms - Basic

• Developing automation scripts.

• Applying utilities like WebLogic. Admin, WebLogic. Deployer etc.

• Integrating with servers.

• Troubleshooting of JAR, EAR, WAR etc

• OCI infra-administration (Install, configure, migrations, tuning, patching, administration monitoring).

• Hands on experience in writing and modifying Terraform scripts for application deployments on OCI and for managing OCI Infrastructure.

• Hands on experience performance tuning, hardware upgrades, and resource optimization as required. Configure CPU, memory, and disk partitions as required and ensure high availability of infrastructure.

• Experience in Application of OS patches and upgrades on a regular basis and upgrade administrative tools and utilities. Configure/add new services as necessary.

• Experience on EXADATA Infrastructure patching on EXACC is added advantage.

• Understanding or experience on Tanium Tool is an added advantage.

• Experience on Handling OS related or Application related security vulnerabilities is an added advantage.

• Exposure to using code repository like GIT.

• Hands on Experience with provisioning storage, compute nodes, network. and understanding requirements for the same.

• Experience with Ansible and YAML syntax.

• Experience in Handling Certificate renewals on OCI.

• Understanding and hands on experience of HA architecture in an OCI environment.

• Strong understanding of HA concepts in DR and setting up on Infrastructure for DR Site.

• Experience with IaaS solutions: virtual machines/networks, on-premise/hybrid cloud computing, cloud identity, security models, cloud monitoring, logging, local and cloud storage.

• Should be well verse with ITIL based service delivery for Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Capacity Management, Configuration Management.

Oracle WebLogic Administrator:

Responsible for deploying and supporting middleware applications using Oracle WebLogic products. The ideal candidate will have a minimum 5 years of experience with middleware administration in a large enterprise environment with a focus on WebLogic.

title: Editor de Vídeo Pleno

EDITOR DE VÍDEO

Somos uma plataforma de anúncios online que nasceu com um propósito claro: descomplicar a vida de quem quer comprar ou vender imóveis e veículos. Crescemos com nossos próprios recursos, sem aportes externos, porque amamos criar e inovar DO NOSSO JEITO.

Somos o primeiro e único portal de anúncios do Brasil a anunciar os dois bens mais desejados do brasileiro: imóveis e veículos.

Hoje, contamos com +15 milhões de acessos mensais na nossa plataforma, +15 mil clientes , e +4.6 milhões de anúncios publicados.

Nosso time é movido por desafios, inovação e aquele brilho nos olhos de quem sabe que tá fazendo história. Já pensou fazer parte de algo gigante assim? 

Aqui, sua carreira pode crescer tanto quanto a gente. Bora?

Conheça o nosso manifesto: 

O mundo é movido por pessoas que fazem acontecer. 

Fazer acontecer é uma maneira de viver. 

Uma maneira de fazer negócios. Uma maneira de realizar.

Reagimos rápido. Nos adaptamos às mudanças. 

Traçamos metas audaciosas e partimos para a ação. 

É nisso que acreditamos. Essa é a nossa essência.

Chegamos até aqui porque cremos em nossos resultados e no nosso propósito de descomplicar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma liderança forte, visão audaciosa, cultura inspiradora e uma equipe composta de pessoas incríveis, formamos uma empresa pungente que pensa no coletivo. 

Afinal, se um ganha, todos ganham.

Nossa ambição é grandiosa. 

E possível.

Prazer. Somos o Chaves na Mão.

Quais são os nossos valores?

Fazemos do nosso jeito: Somos ousados e não tememos trilhar nosso caminho da nossa maneira.

O bife vira: Não desistimos no primeiro obstáculo e cremos sempre que vamos virar o jogo.

Olho no resultado: Nossas ações sempre focam um resultado final e positivo.

Curtimos a jornada: Curtimos a escalada rumo ao topo entendendo que pessoas felizes performam melhor.

Time vencedor joga junto: Sabemos que todo campeonato só é vencido por um time unido pela mesma visão.

ATIVIDADES

  • Editar vídeos curtos para redes sociais e vídeos longos para YouTube

  • Adaptar vídeos para diferentes formatos
  • Organizar arquivos e manter fluxo eficiente de produção
  • Colaborar com creators e marketing para melhoria contínua de performance

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Noção de storytelling para vídeos longos
  • Experiência nos segmentos automotivo e/ ou imobiliário
  • Uso de IA para acelerar processos de edição
  • Capacidade de sugerir melhorias criativas

E o que vai fazer você brilhar os nossos olhos?

  • Ser curioso e proativo: Sempre estar disposto a aprender mais sobre o cliente e a buscar novas estratégias/ ferramentas;
  • Ter a organização nível Jedi: ser organizado em todos os fluxos de trabalho;

title: Organizational Culture Specialist
description:
About the Company

About Us: Keeta is an independent brand under Meituan, which is the world's largest technology-driven retail enterprise. We focus on food and consumer goods delivery services in the international market. Our mission is: "Help people eat better and live better."

About the Role

The role involves leading the development and implementation of our corporate culture strategy, ensuring alignment with our business goals and enhancing employee engagement.

Responsibilities

Culture Strategy & Implementation

  • Culture Framework Development: Lead the development and iteration of the corporate culture system, ensuring strong alignment with company strategy, values, and business goals.
  • Culture Activation Programs: Design and implement culture activation plans (e.g., translating values into observable behaviors, culture training, internal communications) to drive company-wide understanding and practice.
  • Culture Diagnosis & Improvement: Assess the current culture through surveys, interviews, and data analysis; provide improvement recommendations and drive execution.

Culture Branding & Employer Branding

  • Culture Campaigns & Events: Plan and execute culture initiatives (e.g., Values Day, Culture Week, executive dialogues) to strengthen employee belonging and engagement.
  • Employer Brand Integration: Partner with HR and PR teams to embed corporate culture into employer branding efforts (e.g., recruiting, social media, ESG reports).
  • Internal Culture Platforms: Manage internal culture platforms (e.g., internal newsletters/magazines, culture walls, digital communities) to ensure content quality and communication effectiveness.

Leadership Development & Culture Enablement

  • Leadership Culture Training: Provide cultural leadership training for managers and help them become culture ambassadors.
  • Cross-functional Culture Projects: Drive cross-department culture programs (e.g., innovation culture, collaboration culture) to address business pain points.

Globalization & Localization

  • Cross-cultural Alignment: Navigate cultural differences to ensure global consistency while respecting local characteristics.

Qualifications

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree or above; 5+ years of experience in culture-related fields (e.g., corporate culture, cross-cultural management). International/multinational experience and strong insights into multicultural contexts are preferred.
  • Language Skills: English as a working language; able to communicate efficiently in English, collaborate in meetings, and produce written documents.
  • Creative Thinking: Highly creative and idea-driven, with strong execution ability to turn ideas into tangible outcomes.

Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of corporate culture and employee engagement strategies.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in managing culture-related projects in a multinational environment.
  • Hands-on experience in end-to-end event planning and execution, with proven ability to build programs from scratch

Pay range and compensation package

Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Experiência em gestão de produtos digitais

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Para manter a excelência da nossa operação interna e garantir a satisfação contínua de nossos consumidores, buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) Administrativo(a) para guiar e inspirar nosso time de back-office e pós-venda.

Descrição do Cargo

Você será o(a) líder estratégico(a) da nossa equipe administrativa, supervisionando diretamente o time de analistas responsáveis pelo suporte técnico, faturamento e pós-venda financeiro. Sua missão é garantir a fluidez dos processos diários, a exatidão das análises de faturas e rateios, e o mais alto nível de excelência no atendimento e resolução de dúvidas do consumidor final.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe: Gerenciar, treinar e orientar o time de analistas, conduzindo reuniões de alinhamento, aplicando feedbacks contínuos (1:1s) e garantindo um alto nível de motivação e produtividade.
  • Gestão de Faturamento e Compensação: Supervisionar as rotinas de análise aprofundada de faturas de energia, chancelando a precisão dos cálculos de rateio, injeção de excedentes e regras sistêmicas de compensação de energia elétrica.
  • Sucesso do Cliente (Pós-Venda): Atuar como ponto focal e de escalonamento para o atendimento de dúvidas mais complexas dos consumidores, assegurando a resolução de inconsistências junto às distribuidoras de energia e mantendo a qualidade no suporte técnico.
  • Monitoramento de Indicadores (KPIs): Elaborar e acompanhar planilhas e dashboards gerenciais focados em indicadores como SLA de tempo de resposta, precisão do faturamento (evitando bitributação ou erros) e métricas de satisfação do cliente, fornecendo dados para a tomada de decisão da diretoria.
  • Estruturação de Processos: Criar, documentar e otimizar os fluxos de trabalho administrativos, garantindo o uso eficiente das ferramentas de gestão (ERP/CRM) e a correta alimentação de dados do setor.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Ensino Superior completo (ou em fase final) em Engenharia Eletrica, Administração de Empresas, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão Financeira, Economia ou áreas correlatas com forte apelo analítico.
  • Experiência em Gestão: Vivência comprovada na liderança e supervisão de equipes administrativas, de faturamento, suporte ou operações de pós-venda.
  • Domínio do Setor Elétrico: É indispensável possuir conhecimento prático das normativas de Geração Distribuída (GD), leitura técnica de contas de luz e mecânica do Sistema de Compensação de Energia Elétrica (SCEE).
  • Ferramentas: Domínio de nível intermediário/avançado em Microsoft Excel (para gestão de indicadores de equipe) e intimidade com a operação de softwares de gestão de clientes (CRM).
  • Perfil Comportamental: Excelente habilidade de comunicação para negociação e resolução de conflitos, perfil analítico, organização ímpar e inteligência emocional para desenvolver pessoas.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e atendimento ao cliente: É necessário possuir habilidade em comunicação clara e eficiente, tanto verbal quanto escrita, além de experiência em atendimento a clientes, sempre garantindo um serviço de qualidade.
  • Planejamento e habilidades analíticas: Competências em planejamento estratégico e análise de dados para avaliar processos e implementar melhorias são indispensáveis.
  • Gestão orçamentária: Conhecimento sólido em orçamento, incluindo análise e controle financeiro, é essencial.
  • Adicionalmente, serão considerados diferenciais formação na área administrativa ou financeira, conhecimento do setor de energia solar e domínio de ferramentas de ERP.

Experience with e-Procurement and e-Sourcing tools.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência, confiabilidade e escalabilidade das aplicações ao longo de todo o seu ciclo de vida — da estruturação da infraestrutura à operação em produção.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Experiência com CI/CD, principalmente utilizando GitLab CI, incluindo:criação e manutenção de pipelines, estratégias de deploy automatizado, integração com ambientes Kubernetes e versionamento e controle de releases
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade, como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace

title: Especialista em sistemas de granadas
description:
US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha

  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente

  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares
